- CS: active MAU, top 3 features used, any open health issues (one-liners)
- Sales: current stage in legal/procurement (e.g., Legal review / PO requested / Signed T&Cs) and best-case close date

Attachments: NIMBUS_Q2_Milestones.xlsx (internal milestone plan), Nimbus_Usage_Snapshot.pdf (customer usage export).

Thanks — I want to keep this out of the ‘upside’ bucket if we have CS evidence to support commit.

—Naomi
